countRule: Six book/collection witnesses plus one older partial appendix witness supplying the complete 1805 Agreement. Not seven complete books or seven wholly new underlying works.

works.title: The Life of Adoniram Judson
works.author: Edward Judson; dated Adoniram Judson and other correspondence; Emily C. Judson reminiscences
works.edition: New York: Anson D. F. Randolph and Company, 1883; Project Gutenberg 70894 clean transcription
works.completeness: Complete offered text: thirteen chapters and appendix; Edward Judson biography with edited and sometimes condensed primary extracts, not a complete unedited correspondence

works.title: Serampore Letters: William Carey and Others with John Williams, 1800-1816
works.author: William Carey; John Williams; William Ward; Joshua Marshman; John Ryland; other named correspondents; Leighton and Mornay Williams editors; Thomas Wright introduction
works.edition: New York and London: G. P. Putnam's Sons, 1892; University of California copy; Internet Archive offered existing OCR TXT in HTML pre
works.completeness: Complete offered existing text including introduction, letters, notes and conclusion; OCR defects retained, non-text plates not acquired; not a complete Carey correspondence

works.title: The Life of William Carey, Shoemaker & Missionary
works.author: George Smith; quoted Carey and other correspondents; digital preparer John Bechard
works.edition: Project Gutenberg 2056; later revised text of biography first published 1885; Appendix College scheme expressly dated 1909, edition year not silently set to 1885
works.completeness: Complete offered clean text, sixteen chapters, appendix and footnotes; later biography with primary quotations, not a Carey-authored work

works.title: Farewell Letters to a Few Friends in Britain and America, on Returning to Bengal in 1821
works.author: William Ward of Serampore
works.edition: New York: E. Bliss and E. White; Seymour printer, 1821; Library of Congress witness
works.completeness: Complete offered existing readable text: dedication and twenty-six letter essays; plates and scans not acquired; OCR spelling and running-header defects retained

works.title: Memoir of Rev. Luther Rice, One of the First American Missionaries to the East
works.author: James B. Taylor; quoted Luther Rice and other correspondents
works.edition: Baltimore: Armstrong and Berry; Woods and Crane printers, 1840; Library of Congress witness
works.completeness: Complete offered existing readable text, sixteen chapters including journals, letters, concluding religious-sentiments discussion and Charles W. Denison verse; Taylor biography differs from Rice primary documents; cover/library noise and OCR defects retained

works.title: Sermons of Christmas Evans: A New Translation from the Welsh, with a Memoir and Portraiture
works.author: Christmas Evans, sermon author; Joseph Cross, memoir/editor; two translation hands as disclosed in Advertisement
works.edition: Philadelphia: Leary & Getz, 1857; 1846 copyright and Cross Advertisement; Project Gutenberg 42340 transcription
works.completeness: Complete offered clean text, memoir/portraiture and translated sermons; two translation hands disclosed, not Welsh-language originals or an unedited oral transcript

works.title: Serampore Missionary Agreement (1805) and Smith Appendix I-III: Third Section Partial
works.author: Serampore missionary brethren; British and Foreign Bible Society report; George Smith compiler and education memorandum author
works.edition: Carey Center offered HTML of George Smith Life of William Carey (1885), appendix printed pp.441 onward; Agreement 1805, reprinted Calcutta 1874; distinguishes later PG revised appendix
works.completeness: Complete offered HTML bytes; Agreement Appendix I and 1885 translation report Appendix II end cleanly; Appendix III, Smith 29 November 1867 education memorandum, is truncated mid-sentence. Not a complete book or complete appendix; no signature block in Agreement witness.
